item.tib: sangs rgyas don yod zhags pa'i sgrub pa las 'chi bslu'i bar chod kun sel gyi dbu yi gzigs phyogs
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas khro chu'i brag nas spyan drangs te/ slar rgyal mo rong gi nub phyogs dbang gi rgyal po bstan 'dzin gyi pho brang bsam 'grub seng ge'i rdzong nas shog ser las zhal bshus so//
